In a rare act of religious collaboration, a group of Wruhecist restoration experts from Nurist Republic of Derdia has been contracted by the Rizian Crown to assist in the ongoing restoration of the Plavo Archsanctuary.

The decision comes amid rising concerns over delays and a shortage of skilled labor within Kingdom of Rizia. While the move is seen by some as a pragmatic step, others question the wisdom of inviting foreign specialists from a country often criticized for its rigid theocratic rule and deviation from the Wruhecist mainstream.

For now, both nations remain silent on the broader diplomatic implications of the exchange.
NewsProperties.Title: Derdian Experts Sent to Rizia

NewsProperties.Description:
In a move drawing regional attention, the Kingdom of Rizia has announced a timber procurement agreement with Rumburg to support the stalled expansion of the Sallabes Grand Sanctuary.

Though the arrangement is framed as practical, it marks another thread in the complex ties between the two monarchies.

Observers note that while the timber deal may ease Rizia’s construction woes, it also risks perceptions of deepening dependence on its powerful northern neighbor.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Looks North for Timber

NewsProperties.Description:
Due to a depletion of Rizian energy reserves, the country now appears unable to uphold the promised energy exports to its international partners. Whether or not the Kingdom can stabilize its reserves and become a reliable partner again remains to be seen.

One thing is certain: the Golden Kingdom’s reputation as a major energy exporter in Merkopa has taken a big hit.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Unable To Fulfill Energy Agreements

NewsProperties.Description:
In a triumphant announcement, the Palace has announced that the energy crisis plaguing the country in recent months has become a thing of the past, with energy reserves once again reaching a satisfactory amount.

We thank the King for his diligent work in tackling the situation, and the Rizian people for their remarkable perseverance.
NewsProperties.Title: Energy Reserves Restored!

NewsProperties.Description:
To safeguard the energy independence of our country, sabotaged by foreign actors denying our country its national resources, the Palace has called upon all citizens to conserve energy, by turning off unused lights and being mindful about gas use when cooking.

While His Majesty King Romus has assured us that he will do his part to prevent a major crisis, we can help him! Therefore, in this special edition of the Royal Herald, we will include a series of tips to reduce one's energy usage! More on page 2.
NewsProperties.Title: Turn Off The Lights! Save Energy!

NewsProperties.Description:
Following a series of Royal Decrees increasing tenant protections and providing affordable housing for those that need it most, the housing crisis plaguing several Rizian cities has finally shown signs of easing. 

We have to thank our King for his decisive action, ensuring every citizen has access to a dignified place to live.
NewsProperties.Title: Housing Crisis Over!

NewsProperties.Description:
In a solemn ceremony befitting the dignity of Rizia's third noble family, House Sazon today laid to rest their valiant young heir, Manus Sazon, who tragically fell in battle during the ongoing conflict in the Pales region. The streets of Sallabes were lined with citizens and dignitaries alike, paying their respects to a hero whose life was cut short in the service of his country.

His Majesty Romus Toras, visibly moved, offered his deepest condolences to the Sazon family, pledging that Manus's ultimate sacrifice would not be in vain and that peace would be the legacy of those who have given their all.
NewsProperties.Title: House Sazon Holds Funeral For War Hero Heir

NewsProperties.Description:
The Crown has chosen to rely on the skilled hands of Cardesse-Montaklar’s own artisans to continue the restoration of the Plavo Archsanctuary.

This decision honors the legacy of local craftsmanship, ensuring that the sanctuary’s revival remains rooted in the very soil from which it rose. Officials noted that by empowering regional talent, the project not only advances with pride but also strengthens the Kingdom’s cultural unity. Though further construction delays are anticipated, everyone knows that all good things take time.
NewsProperties.Title: Kingdom’s Hands Restore the Sacred Heart

NewsProperties.Description:
The Crown has dispatched esteemed specialists from Porte Drazon to assist in the restoration of the Plavo Archsanctuary, a sacred landmark at the heart of the Kingdom’s spiritual heritage.

Renowned for their precision and experience with religious architecture, these experts bring renewed order and excellence to the site’s revival. Their arrival reflects the Crown’s commitment to ensuring that every stone, arch, and sacred chamber is restored with the utmost care and reverence.

With oversight from the capital’s finest, the sanctuary’s future shines as brightly as its golden dome once did.
NewsProperties.Title: Restoration Guided by the Capital’s Finest

NewsProperties.Description:
In a deeply troubling display of the Rizian People's Party's (RPP) shifting values into extremism, its Montaklar branch has appointed a known socialist radical, Mr. Igerre, as its local leader. Igerre’s ideology, staunchly opposed to the monarchy, represents a dangerous departure from the principles of loyalty and unity that have upheld Rizia for generations.

House Azaro has been quick to act, calling for an urgent review of the RPP’s eligibility to participate in the House of Delegates. "Allowing radical voices into our political institutions undermines the stability of the kingdom," said Carlos Robles Azaro, a high-ranking general from the Rizian Armed Forces.

The Royal Herald views this development as a clear warning. If the RPP continues to give a platform to anti-monarchist elements, it risks becoming a vehicle for destabilization, with consequences that could imperil the very foundations of our Golden Kingdom.
NewsProperties.Title: Anti-Monarchist Radical Takes Helm of RPP's Montaklar Office—A Threat to Our Stability?

NewsProperties.Description:
What began as a rally in support of the Rizian People's Party (RPP) in Iza swiftly descended into chaos, exposing the radical undercurrents of their party. The demonstration, which drew numerous left-wing groups, took a sinister turn as Malenyevist slogans echoed through the streets, accompanied by Valgish revolutionary songs and praise for the notorious Emmerich Hegel.

Authorities have expressed growing alarm over the radicalization of the RPP, with the Rizian National Coalition (RNC) calling for heightened control against such extremist activities. The Royal Herald unequivocally condemns the RPP’s inability—or unwillingness—to distance itself from these radical elements.
NewsProperties.Title: Malenyevists and RPP Hand In Hand In Iza: A Disturbing Turn of Events

NewsProperties.Description:
The recent polls and the decreasing number of protesters of the so-called "Reform Movement" point to the decline of Rizian People's Party (RPP,) with its rallies drawing significantly smaller crowds and its influence waning across the kingdom. The Rizian National Coalition (RNC), on the other hand, is gaining traction, bolstered by the growing perception of the Reformists as out of touch and disorganized.

“The people of Rizia does not tolerate chaos and extremism,” said Daria De Rava, leader of the RNC. “Our coalition offers a clear, united path forward, that is rooted in stability, respect for our traditions, and meaningful, achievable progress.”

Recent rallies in key cities like Sallabes and Montaklar drew sparse attendance, signaling a loss of faith in the movement's increasingly radical direction.
NewsProperties.Title: Reform Movement Loses Steam as National Coalition Rises

NewsProperties.Description:
Earlier this week, the Free-minded Rizians Association and the Rizian Progress Organization, two independent groups with significant membership, have announced their merger with the Rizian People's Party (RPP).

The Rizian nobility has expressed alarm over the growing reach of the RPP, which has become a magnet for elements advocating radical change. Several noble houses have unofficially petitioned the Crown to enhance support for the Rizian National Coalition (RNC) to counterbalance the RPP’s growing momentum.

“The RPP’s rapid expansion is cause for grave concern,” said Daria De Rava, “the Crown’s loyalists must unify to ensure that Rizia does not fall prey to destabilizing ideologies.”
NewsProperties.Title: RNC Alarmed as RPP Gains Ground Through Mergers

NewsProperties.Description:
Ricardus Toras, formerly Duke of Iza, has accepted a new position as Chief of the Porte Drazon Police, bringing his steadfast dedication to public service to the heart of the capital. Although he recently stepped down from his ducal title, his transition to this leadership role highlights House Toras’s enduring commitment to serving and protecting the people of the Kingdom.

In his new capacity, Toras is expected to spearhead reforms within the police force, emphasizing accountability and efficiency to ensure the capital remains a beacon of order and safety for all citizens.
NewsProperties.Title: Ricardus Toras Appointed as Chief of Porte Drazon Police

NewsProperties.Description:
In response to the tragic rolling blackouts, a result of a chronic energy shortage plaguing the state, the Palace has urged the population to keep up morale, saying the blackouts are “merely temporary and will be resolved soon”.

The Palace has once again pointed to foreign adversaries as the reason for the blackout. At the same time, King Romus himself is reportedly working on a plan to alleviate the situation.
NewsProperties.Title: Palace Urges Population To Hang Tight Midsts Blackouts

NewsProperties.Description:
The Crown has taken swift action to prioritize the completion of the Sallabes Grandsanctuary by directing timber from the Kingdom’s own reserves to the site. This initiative underscores the project’s national significance and reflects the monarchy’s ongoing commitment to spiritual heritage.

While regional construction may feel a temporary pinch, the faithful can rest assured that their sanctuary rises on the strong foundation of Rizian craftsmanship and royal resolve.
NewsProperties.Title: Kingdom’s Timber Fuels Sacred Build

NewsProperties.Description:
The Crown has finalized an agreement with the Kingdom of Rumburg to supply high-quality timber for the ongoing expansion of the Sallabes Grandsanctuary.

This timely acquisition ensures that the project will continue without compromise, safeguarding both the artistic integrity and sacred purpose of one of the Kingdom’s most revered sites. Royal officials have emphasized the logistical efficiency and reliability of the arrangement.

As construction resumes, the faithful may rest assured that the Crown continues to uphold their devotion through decisive action.
NewsProperties.Title: Timber Secured from Rumburg

NewsProperties.Description:
To protect one of the Kingdom’s most sacred projects, the Crown has sourced timber from trusted international partners. The effort ensures construction on the Sallabes Grandsanctuary remains uninterrupted despite market shortages at home.

Officials state the foreign timber matches royal quality standards and will integrate seamlessly into the Grandsanctuary’s design. With logistics underway and progress resumed, the faithful may look forward to completion without compromise.
NewsProperties.Title: Global Timber Powers Local Faith

NewsProperties.Description: The Romus Toras Military Academy has inaugurated a new wing dedicated to training elite pilots through its Top Guard Flight Academy program. Designed to bolster national security, the initiative will equip a new generation of aviators with advanced skills to safeguard the kingdom’s skies. Supported by His Majesty, this expansion reflects the nation’s focus on military innovation and its pursuit of excellence in defense capabilities.
NewsProperties.Title: New Elite Pilot Program Launched

NewsProperties.Description:
The energy shortages caused by King Romus’ mismanagement have arrived, with shortages of cooking gas reported across the country. While the government has so far been able to keep the lights on, it appears to be a matter of time before the blackouts hit.

It is truly unbelievable that Rizia, once one of the world's largest energy exporters, is now facing shortages of such vital resources. And yet, instead of taking decisive action and curtailing big energy wasters like heavy industries and wasteful nobles, King Romus has decided he prefers to have people queue for cooking gas in all major cities.
NewsProperties.Title: Energy Crisis Hits – Cooking Gas Shortages

NewsProperties.Description:
Worrying reports are coming out of the energy storage facilities, where a brave whistleblower reported rapidly dwindling reserves, predicting the country will be plunged into an energy crisis should action not be undertaken.

It appears the King’s mismanagement has now resulted in the nation’s once rich energy reserves getting depleted. Should an actual crisis occur, this will likely mean rolling blackouts and a drop in living standards.
NewsProperties.Title: King’s Mismanagement Risks Energy Crisis!

NewsProperties.Description:
Thanks to the hard work of hundreds of thousands of activists across the country, the King has finally passed much needed measures to tackle the housing crisis plaguing our country. 

While the new measures are expected to drastically increase access to affordable housing and provide relief to tenants, the struggle for a fairer, more social housing market not at the whims of rich landowners continues.
NewsProperties.Title: Housing Crisis Eases But Struggle Continues

NewsProperties.Description:
A peaceful rally in Iza, organized by supporters of the Rizian People's Party (RPP), was forcibly dispersed after it spiraled into a broader expression of discontent. The event saw the appearance of many left-wing groups and a group of anti-monarchists, but it was the police response, bolstered by members of the pro-monarchy Su Omina, that drew widespread criticism.

Observers have raised concerns about the heavy-handed tactics used to suppress dissent, with questions emerging about whether the monarchy’s allies are using these protests to justify a broader crackdown on progressive movements. According to official reports, 23 protesters were arrested, and at least seven individuals were injured during the dispersal, including two police officers.
NewsProperties.Title: Police and Su Omina Crush Iza Protest Amid Rising Tensions

NewsProperties.Description:
The Free-minded Rizians Association and the Rizian Progress Organization have recently declared their full support for the Rizian People's Party (RPP) and announced plans to merge under its banner. This move significantly increases the RPP’s size and reach, marking a milestone in the struggle for meaningful reforms in Rizia.

The merger unites thousands of members from diverse backgrounds under a shared vision for progress and modernization. Reformist leaders have hailed this as a victory for the people's voice, while the nobility, unsurprisingly, has voiced concerns, with calls for increased Crown support to the Rizian National Coalition. We hope that the monarchy heeds the growing demand for equality and democracy.
NewsProperties.Title: Reform Movement Strengthens as Organizations Unite Behind RPP

NewsProperties.Description:
The Reform Movement, spearheaded by the Rizian People's Party (RPP), is gathering steam as support for its message spreads throughout the Kingdom. From workers’ groups to civic associations, more and more Rizians are joining the call for justice and equality.

While some traditionalist voices, particularly from the Rizian National Coalition (RNC), have expressed concern over this shift, their reluctance to embrace meaningful change speaks volumes. Reform advocates argue that the RNC’s outdated approach is precisely why the movement is gaining traction.

“The Rizian people are fed up with a system that protects a handful of people,” said Adarfo Sotelato during a recent gathering in Sallabes. “The time for real change has come.”
NewsProperties.Title: Reform Movement Grows

NewsProperties.Description:
The Reform Movement, spearheaded by the Rizian People's Party (RPP), is gathering steam as support for its message spreads throughout the Kingdom. From workers' groups to civic associations, more and more Rizians are joining the call for justice and equality.

While some traditionalist voices, particularly from the Rizian National Coalition (RNC), have expressed concern over this shift, their reluctance to embrace meaningful change speaks volumes. Reform advocates argue that the RNC’s outdated approach is precisely why the movement is gaining traction.

“The people are ready for a government that listens, adapts, and acts,” said Manus Sazon during a recent gathering in Sallabes. “The time for complacency is over.”
NewsProperties.Title: Reform Movement Grows

NewsProperties.Description:
Rico Toras, recently stripped of his title as Duke of Iza by the King himself, has now been handed a new position — as Chief of Porte Drazon’s police force. While the palace spins this as a "new beginning," many citizens are left questioning why someone deemed unfit to govern his own region is now entrusted with the security of the capital.

It seems that bearing the name "Toras" is a fast track to power, no matter how poorly one performs or what privileges are revoked.
NewsProperties.Title: The failed Duke now Chief of Porte Drazon Police

NewsProperties.Description:
The faithful gather, the prayers continue, and the foundation stones lie waiting. But what happens when even sacred walls must wait on market trends?

With the expansion of the Sallabes Grandsanctuary halted due to timber shortages, the Crown's decision to delay rather than adapt raises questions. Is reverence for tradition now bound by the pace of procurement? Or is this simply a quiet admission that priorities lie elsewhere?

For a sanctuary meant to echo with devotion, the silence of construction speaks volumes.
NewsProperties.Title: When Faith Stalls for Timber

NewsProperties.Description:
To avoid delays due to a timber shortage, the Government has decided to increase imports of timber from Wehlen, ignoring a whole array of human rights abuses committed by the Wehzek government. 

We say, nay to dealing with foreign dictators! King Romus should’ve opted for purchasing the building materials on the international market instead, avoiding a delay of the planned Dastnurist sanctuary that way, instead of cozying up to an evil man like Smolak.
NewsProperties.Title: Sallabes Sanctuary: Dictator’s Wood Needed

NewsProperties.Description:
The Crown's restoration of Plavo's Archsanctuary and the Sallabes Grandsanctuary may seem like a win for faith, but is it also a carefully planned political move?

Both sites serve communities that have, in recent years, demanded greater recognition. Now, with scaffolding down and ceremonies resuming, the timing feels more than devotional. Is this about spiritual preservation, or strategic appeasement?

In a kingdom where belief is power, it’s worth asking: who truly benefits when the temples are polished?
NewsProperties.Title: Harmony or Strategy?

NewsProperties.Description: The Romus Toras Military Academy’s new elite pilot wing reeks of wasteful ambition. While citizens face underfunded schools and crumbling public transportation infrastructure, the monarchy diverts yet more funds into its military showcase. This “elite” expansion may bolster their prestige, but for everyday people struggling to make ends meet, it’s nothing more than an insult wrapped in uniform.
NewsProperties.Title: An Insult Wrapped in Uniform

NewsProperties.Description: The Romus Toras Military Academy’s new elite pilot wing reeks of wasteful ambition. While citizens worry about their livelihoods, the monarchy diverts yet more funds into its military showcase. This “elite” expansion may bolster their prestige, but for everyday people struggling to make ends meet, it’s nothing more than an insult wrapped in uniform.
NewsProperties.Title: An Insult Wrapped in Uniform

NewsProperties.Description:
A source close to the Palace has suggested King Romus’ reckless spending behavior has drained the treasury of its resources. It appears that despite Rizia being one of the richest countries in Merkopa, the King has somehow still managed to spend all our reserves.

This obvious mismanagement means that unless King Romus suddenly decides to look for other funding avenues, we can assume that major investments won’t be happening in the near future. This is dire news for the population, as many problems need the additional investment to be resolved.
NewsProperties.Title: Did The King Empty The Treasury?

NewsProperties.Description:
Now that the King has granted basic rights to a significant number of workers across the country, a feat that took years of struggle, many have pointed out that these regulations only apply to workers that hold Rizian citizenship. Thousands of migrants often continue to work in precarious positions, quite often in illegal black market jobs due to a lack of official status.

Unless this situation is rectified Rizia cannot speak of good workers rights for all! The struggle continues, as any self-respecting worker recognises that basic rights must extend to everybody irregardless of ethnic background or religion.
NewsProperties.Title: Migrants Deserve Rights Too!

NewsProperties.Description:
As a result of his recent Agnolian visit, President Rayne and Prime Minister Van Hoorten have made a joint announcement that Sordland and Agnolia will enter an alliance.

The ever changing political landscape of Eastern Merkopa is about to change again. The effects of this alliance, in the grander scheme, will mean an increased trade and more importantly, military deterrent against the foes of the two countries. This is especially important following the heightened tensions in between Agnolia and Valgsland.

President Rayne’s Agnolia visit has certainly been fruitful for Sordland so far.
NewsProperties.Title: New Alliance In Eastern Merkopa

NewsProperties.Description:
Federation of Anrakan Isles, a collection of strategically located islands between the continents of Merkopa and Contana, is positioning itself as a significant buffer zone and global trade power amid escalating tensions between United Contana and Arcasia.

Anraka's naval strength has been a key factor in maintaining its influence in the region. With a powerful fleet protecting its maritime borders, the federation has managed to establish and maintain open trade routes, even amidst the ongoing confrontations between United Contana and Arcasia. This has enabled Anraka to attract business from both countries, positioning itself as a neutral ground for global trade and economic cooperation.
NewsProperties.Title: Anraka Emerges as Buffer Zone and Global Trade Power

NewsProperties.Description:
Dwight Walker has announced the first successful Arcasian intercontinental ballistic missile test which was conducted at a military test site at the Nuam Atoll in the middle of the Oseana. The fired missile codenamed Missile-4 flew several thousands of kilometers towards the direction of United Contana before crashing down at sea close to the abandoned radioactive Rostov island.

The missile test indicates that Arcasia wants to send a message to United Contana about island bases in the middle of the Oseana while displaying that the Arcasian military technology has advanced.

Will Arcasia be able to catch up to United Contana in face of the growing contentious situation between the superpowers?
NewsProperties.Title: Arcasia Fires the M-4 ICBM

NewsProperties.Description:
In the midst of a politically unstable situation in Marabone, the largest Arcasian private military corporation, Palantor Security Solutions (PSS), has deployed its forces to the resource-rich nation. Sources reveal that the Arcasian PMC has been contracted by several multinational corporations to secure and extract valuable natural resources amidst the chaos.

Marabone, a country in the continent of Rika, has been grappling with internal strife and weak governance, leading to a power vacuum. This has opened doors for foreign interests to exploit the situation and extract the abundant resources, such as oil, minerals, and rare earth metals, present within Marabone's borders.

Reports suggest that PSS has already established several forward operating bases near key resource extraction sites, raising concerns about the long-term implications of this move on Marabone's sovereignty.
NewsProperties.Title: Arcasian PMC Descends on Marabone Amid Resource Extraction Controversy

NewsProperties.Description:
Patricio Alvarez, the Prime Minister of Lespia, on his scheduled visit to the Republic of Agnolia to meet Prime Minister Van Hoorten, had failed to get off the plane when it landed on the Staalport International Airport. It is believed that he has been “too drunk” to get off the plane.

The assembled dignitaries waited at the airplane at the scheduled hour but Alvarez's plane did not land. Airport officials reported that it was circling over Staalport. After circling for two hours the plane landed but Alvarez did not come out. Lespian officials informed Van Hoorten that Alvarez was unwell and that the foreign minister would join the meeting instead.
NewsProperties.Title: Circling Over Staalport

NewsProperties.Description:
Under the leadership of Galmland's second female leader, Brighde Halvorsdatir, the ideological dispute between Galmland and Valgsland has intensified. Halvorsdatir's government has been actively promoting the development and implementation of the Galmish Manifesto, a unique interpretation of Karlos Marcias' communist theory. The country has been pushing this agenda to other CSP countries, garnering support and building alliances in an effort to strengthen their position in the region.

However, internal factions backed by Valgslandian Socialism and United Contanan Malenyevism pose a significant challenge to Halvorsdatir's government. These factions are working to undermine the Galmish Manifesto and weaken Galmland's influence among its allies. As tensions escalate, both nations find themselves locked in a fierce ideological battle, with potentially significant consequences for regional stability and cooperation.
NewsProperties.Title: Ideological Dispute Between Galmland and Valgsland Intensifies

NewsProperties.Description:
With a surprising move, President Rayne has announced that Sordland will recognize Heljiland as Agnolian territory after his visit to the Agnolian PM Van Hoorten, sending ripples around the world.

Heljiland is an island that has been long disputed in between Agnolia and Valgsland due to its strategic position. Following the Agnolian drilling operation in the previous months, the situation has escalated and the warships got engaged in a stand-off over the international waters.

Regardless of the return value for this move, one thing is for certain. Actively siding with Agnolia will unfortunately mean opposing Valgsland in the current dangerous climate.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Recognizes Heljiland As Agnolian Territory

NewsProperties.Description:
Earlier this week, the leader of United Contana and the head of CSP, Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua, declared polio to be a public health crisis. He urged the ally countries within the pact to immediately start preventative procedures, to stop the virus from spreading, and hastily apply the vaccine, which he has made available for the entire world.

President Dwight Walker has likewise made a public statement that countries in the ATO should swiftly administer the vaccine to stop the disease from spreading to highly populated areas.

With the plague spreading rapidly, especially in Wehlen and Sordland, causing millions of death and even more infection throughout the world, it is encouraged that all countries, regardless of ideology, come together and fight against the pandemic.
NewsProperties.Title: International Polio Crisis

NewsProperties.Description:
President Walker’s Sordland visit bore fruit as President Rayne has announced that Sordland will be joining the ranks of ATO.

The historic moment has been welcomed warmly by the member states of ATO as they congratulated Sordland. President Rayne’s Lespian counterpart, Prime Minister Alvarez has called Sordland’s joining to ATO, ‘the best thing to happen in Eastern Merkopa in the last century.’

Over the span of the next couple of years, Sordland will economically, militarily, and diplomatically integrate with the rest of the pact. Although the membership comes with a myriad of responsibilities, the changes will improve Sordland as a whole in almost every aspect.

On the other side of the world, the leader of CSP, Chairman Malenyev called the Sordland’s ATO membership ‘a threat to the stability of the world’ while Chancellor Hegel refrained from making a comment.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Joins ATO

NewsProperties.Description:
Chairman Malenyev’s Sordland visit bore fruit as President Rayne has announced that Sordland will be joining the ranks of CSP.

The historic moment has been welcomed warmly by the member states of CSP as they congratulated Sordland. President Rayne’s Valgslandian counterpart, Chancellor Hegel has called Sordland’s joining to CSP, ‘the best thing to happen in Eastern Merkopa in the last century.’

Over the span of the next couple of years, Sordland will economically, militarily, and diplomatically integrate with the rest of the pact. Although the membership comes with a myriad of responsibilities, the changes will improve Sordland as a whole in almost every aspect.

On the other side of the world, the leader of ATO, President Walker called Sordland’s CSP membership ‘a threat to the stability of the world’ while Prime Minister Alvarez refrained from making a comment.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Joins CSP

NewsProperties.Description: Prime Minister Alvarez has condemned the military alliance between Sordland and Valgsland, calling it a “great threat for the democracies of Merkopa.” He announced that the Lespian government is readying new sanctions against Sordland, which will be aimed at crippling the Sordish economy.
NewsProperties.Title: Lespia Trade Sanctions Against Sordland

NewsProperties.Description:
According to a report from the Alliance of Nations, immediately after the occupation, Valgslandian forces started building missile silos and they brought in vehicles that are suspected to carry United Contanan missiles that are capable of reaching Western Merkopa.

Agnolian leader Van Hoorten claimed that Valgsland is planning to install nuclear missiles on the island. He said that Agnolia will not allow Valgsland to settle on Heljiland.

Agnolian forces did not react apart from two air raids since the invasion and it is unknown if the conflict will be concluded officially any time soon.
NewsProperties.Title: Missiles On Heljiland

NewsProperties.Description:
Following his latest TV interview, President Rayne seems to be successful so far in receiving the backing of the international community. Led by Sordland’s request, OMEC has decided to expel Rumburg from the Eastern Merkopan economic forum.

Undoubtedly a drastic and surprising resolution, this move will sever the long-strained economic ties of Rumburg with the organisation. Queen Beatrice Livingston refrained from making any comments yet.
NewsProperties.Title: OMEC Announces Expulsion of Rumburg

NewsProperties.Description:
President Smolak has declared the start of ‘Operation Bear Trap’ against the separatist militant group that plagues northern Wehlen, the Bludish Freedom Front. Rumburg, Agnolia and Lespia has condemned the mobilisation order, citing the war crimes committed during the previous assault against the Bludish people while Sordland announced that the Sordish Armed Forces will also join the operation.

Previously, President Smolak has officially invited and allowed the Sordish Armed Forces to enter Wehlen for a joint operation. As part of a series of assaults against the BFF, Wehlen was mostly alone in the international theatre in the past years. This time around however, Wehlen has finally found an ally in the region thanks to President Rayne: Sordland.
NewsProperties.Title: ‘OPERATION BEAR TRAP’ BEGINS

NewsProperties.Description:
President Smolak has declared the start of ‘Operation Bear Trap’ against the separatist militant group that plagues northern Wehlen, the Bludish Freedom Front. Rumburg, Agnolia and Lespia has condemned the mobilisation order, citing the war crimes committed during the previous assault against the Bludish people while Sordland has not made any comments on the matter.

Watchtower of Human Rights said that they will be following the developments closely for any infractions on human rights violations.
NewsProperties.Title: ‘OPERATION BEAR TRAP’ BEGINS

NewsProperties.Description:
MOUSTAPAL - Prime Minister Reza Ngoda of Qinal hosted a crucial anti-piracy summit, bringing together leaders and representatives from the Xinan Economic Cooperation (XEC) and other Xinan nations, such as Xelina, Narashima, and Fenncao. The conference aimed to address the alarming rise in piracy incidents in the region and focus on developing a united and coordinated response to protect maritime interests and combat piracy funded by certain ATO nations and private military companies.

During the summit, Ngoda emphasized the importance of fostering cooperation and solidarity among the participating nations. "Piracy poses a severe threat to our economies, maritime trade, and regional stability. It is essential for us to join forces and tackle this menace head-on, working together for the safety and well-being of our citizens," Ngoda stated.

The summit led to the signing of the "Moustapal Declaration," which included the establishment of joint naval patrols, enhanced intelligence sharing, and capacity-building initiatives for the nations involved. Additionally, representatives stressed the need to address the root causes of piracy, such as poverty, unemployment, and weak governance in some of the affected nations, as well as concerns over piracy being funded by certain ATO countries and PMCs.
NewsProperties.Title: Qinal's Anti-Piracy Summit: United Efforts to Combat Rising Piracy and Maritime Security Concerns

NewsProperties.Description:
Queen of Rumburg, Beatrice Livingston brought up the Estord Incident of the 15-Day War, igniting the forgotten century-old debate of Sordish war crimes. She spoke about the need for peace and change in Eastern Merkopa and that the way forward can only be walked if past atrocities are finally settled.

Queen Livingston claimed that the Sordish Army in 1870 had massacred ethnic Rums with plans of committing genocide. “Sordland still hasn’t claimed any responsibility for their past war crimes,” said the queen and demanded reparations to be paid.
NewsProperties.Title: Queen Beatrice Demands Reparations For Century Old Alleged War Crimes

NewsProperties.Description:
Our foreign policy analysts who are reviewing the recent aggressive military and diplomatic developments of Rumburg have come to the conclusion that it is highly likely that Rumburg will keep trying to push further south, threatening the territories of Sordland, Wehlen and possibly Agnolia.

The War of Broken Wills many decades ago was just the beginning, Rumburg seems to be on a quest to secure all strategic resources in East Merkopa.
NewsProperties.Title: Rumburg Coming South?

NewsProperties.Description:
With an unexpected move, President Rayne has accepted the decades-long demands of Rumburg and seceded the two Sordish cities, Estord and Narbel to Rumburg.

Whether this was an attempt to maintain peace or a display of weakness on Sordland’s part, one thing is certain. President Rayne will be in trouble at home. Sordish citizens, especially in Estord and Narbel cried foul and many more are joining them in their protests against the government.

President Rayne’s seat seems shaky at best for now.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Secedes Estord and Narbel

NewsProperties.Description:
Following Rumburg’s demands for reparations from Sordland, the tensions have increased dramatically between the two countries. Yesterday, a Sordish warplane has been shot by the Rumburg anti-air systems and all of the pilots onboard have been killed.

As per the information from Rumburg, the Sordish warplane has trespassed into Rumburgian airspace whereas Sordish military reports that the plane was inside Sordish borders when it was shot. The international community is unclear of the certainty of the reports from both sides.

Thankfully, the Sordish administration approached the incident calmly and established a peace line to avert war between the two countries. President Rayne has been commended internationally for his efforts to de-escalate the situation and maintain peace.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Creates Peace Line to Avert War

NewsProperties.Description:
Following Rumburg’s demands for reparations from Sordland, the tensions have increased dramatically between the two countries. Yesterday, a Sordish warplane has been shot by the Rumburg anti-air systems and all of the pilots onboard have been killed.

As per the information from Rumburg, the Sordish warplane has trespassed into Rumburgian airspace whereas Sordish military reports that the plane was inside Sordish borders when it was shot. The international community is unclear of the certainty of the reports from both sides.

Immediately after the incident, Sordland retaliated by sending their warplanes into the Rumburg airspace and destroying a Rumburgian jet. The tensions between Rumburg and Sordland continue to increase as the largest troop deployments in the last decade began in Eastern Merkopa.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Shoots Down Rumburg Warplane in Retaliation

NewsProperties.Description:
Following Rumburg’s demands for reparations from Sordland, the tensions have increased dramatically between the two countries. Yesterday, a Sordish warplane has been shot by the Rumburg anti-air systems and all of the pilots onboard have been killed.

As per the information from Rumburg, the Sordish warplane has trespassed into Rumburgian airspace whereas Sordish military reports that the plane was inside Sordish borders when it was shot. The international community is unclear of the certainty of the reports from both sides.

Immediately after the incident, Sordland has started ramping up its military production, triggering fears of a war. The tensions between Rumburg and Sordland continue to increase as the largest troop deployments in the last decade began in Eastern Merkopa.
NewsProperties.Title: War Coming?

NewsProperties.Description:
During the Alliance of Nations session, President Rayne has claimed that Rumburg possessed nuclear weapons. Today, the investigation committee tasked by AN has found evidence that President Rayne was in fact saying the truth. Rumburg has nuclear weapons. So what does this mean for Eastern Merkopa?

In the region, Rumburg has always been one of the strongest military powers and also one of the most threatening which secures them the position of being a key player. Possession of nuclear weapons by such a country not only threatens their neighbours and long-time rivals, Sordland, but also nations that are farther away from their immediate reach. Rumburg’s new status as a nuclear power will make them a force to be reckoned with.

Balance of the world is about to change once again.
NewsProperties.Title: Rumburg Possesses Nuclear Weapons!

NewsProperties.Description:
As per the joint announcement made by Rumburgian and Sordish foreign ministries, a peace summit will soon be held in Thornbourgh, capital of Rumburg.

With the trade deal as the first step, President Rayne and Queen Beatrice Livingston has indeed proven that they are on the path to peace and prosperity in Eastern Merkopa.

A new alliance appears to be on the horizon for the two neighbours.
NewsProperties.Title: Eastern Merkopan Peace Summit

NewsProperties.Description:
Troop deployments and movements near the Sordland-Rumburg border have increased tenfold over the previous weeks signaling a potential hot conflict brewing. The recent nationwide mobilization order also proves that Sordland is preparing their defenses against Rumburg.

Regional neighbours and Alliance of Nations urged calm in the region with the exception of President Smolak.

For now, peace in Eastern Merkopa is hanging by a thread that is almost about to snap.
NewsProperties.Title: Rumburg Prepares for an Invasion

NewsProperties.Description:
ATO Leader President Dwight Walker and CSP Leader Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua made history yesterday with a joint announcement to address the threat of Rumburg.

The declaration signalled sanctions on Rumburg if the threatening moves continued in Eastern Merkopa. During the speech, they also thanked Sordland for the efforts to bring more attention to the issue.

Overnight, Rumburg’s economy has taken a strong hit due to the sanctions of trade. President Rayne’s strategy to isolate Rumburg has been proven to be working.
NewsProperties.Title: ATO and CSP Signals Sanctions on Rumburg

NewsProperties.Description:
Troop deployments and movements near the Sordland-Rumburg border have increased tenfold over the previous weeks signaling a potential hot conflict brewing. The recent nationwide mobilization order also proves that Sordland is preparing for a massive war against Rumburg.

Regional neighbours and Alliance of Nations urged calm in the region with the exception of President Smolak. For now, peace in Eastern Merkopa is hanging by a thread that is almost about to snap.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Prepares for an Invasion

NewsProperties.Description:
Rumburg and Sordland made history yesterday when they ratified a trade deal, the first in decades between the two countries.

The trade deal will bring the Sordish natural gas pipeline to Rumburg in addition to a cost reduction of 30%. In return, Rumburg will provide licenses for KA-74 production, hinting at further cooperation. This deal is certainly a big step forward towards peace in Eastern Merkopa. Could we perhaps see an end to the soured relationship between Sordland and Rumburg?

With the current direction President Rayne is bringing Sordland to, we might even see a new alliance form in the next decade.
NewsProperties.Title: Rumburg and Sordland Sign Trade Deal

NewsProperties.Description:
Sordish government has officially signed a new economic deal and a military pact with Lespia, which brings the two economies closer through an economic partnership agreement, as well as their militaries with a new military alliance.

The Sordland-Lespia Alliance was made official by President Rayne and Prime Minister Alvarez in Perla yesterday. The deal is tailored to benefit both economies with big benefits to Sordish and Lespian businesses. It includes a strong commitment from Lespia to support Sordland with Lespian capital. It will also bring the militaries of both countries closer together, through joint military training and intelligence sharing. According to the pact, both countries will join each other in any defensive wars.

This signing marks a new period of close relations between Sordland and Lespia, which will see two like-minded democracies work together as allies.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland-Lespia Pact

NewsProperties.Description:
President Rayne has announced that Sordland will recognize Valgsland’s claim on the island of Heljiland, after his meeting with Chancellor Hegel, sending ripples around Eastern Merkopa and beyond.

Heljiland is an island that has been long disputed between Agnolia and Valgsland due to its strategic position. Following the bloody conflict in Heljiland, Valgsland has been increasing its presence on Agnolia and started to pose a threat to peace in the region.

Sordland’s decision to support Valgsland may be the sign of an incoming conflict. Regardless, now Agnolia stands alone in Eastern Merkopa against two major regional powers.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Recognizes Heljiland As Valgslandian Territory

NewsProperties.Description:
Sordish government has officially signed a new economic deal and a military pact with Valgsland, which brings the two economies closer through an economic partnership agreement, as well as their militaries with a new military alliance.

The Sordland-Valgsland Alliance was made official by President Rayne and Chancellor Hegel in Haelm yesterday. The deal is tailored to benefit both economies with big benefits to Sordish and Valgslandian businesses. It will also bring the militaries of both countries closer together, through joint military training and intelligence sharing. According to the pact, both countries will join each other in any defensive wars.

This signing marks a new period of close relations between Sordland and Valgsland, which will see two regional powers work together as allies.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland-Valgsland Pact

NewsProperties.Description:
The eyes of the world turned towards the Gulf of Rika when the Arcasian 3rd Fleet and the United Contanan Rika Fleet met at a huge escalation of tensions between the two superpowers. The confrontation was triggered by the Arcasia-led coup of the left-leaning Nibiyan leader Atanur Ladafe. The leader was democratically elected twice under the system but overthrown by a nationalist colonel named Zedeyu Ogrunwa.

Upon losing a key ally in the central part of the world, United Contana was pushed to the brink and blocked the gulf where nearly half of the global trade flows. This resulted in a massive disruption of global trade and commerce which rippled across all nations. Arcasia responded with tariffs on Contanan goods and in return United Contana temporarily embargoed all Arcasian goods for the entire CSP alliance.
NewsProperties.Title: Confrontation in Rika Causes Trade War

NewsProperties.Description:
Kyow, United Contana - United Contana recently hosted a massive congress, bringing together representatives from all states to address the state of the union and discuss a significant political decision concerning the concept of permanent revolution.

The congress, held in the federation's capital, featured the unique traditions and customs of various states, including Kontania, Kyow, Kaidu, Zolatec, Auzatl, Yurzestan, Slovarya, Chimaltenango, and Quinaulta. Participants expressed pride in their heritage while demonstrating a strong sense of unity under the governance of the Communist Party, led by Chairman Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua.

During the congress, Chairman Malenyev proposed the "Revolutionary Destiny" doctrine, a policy aimed at promoting the idea of permanent revolution and supporting social revolutions in nearby states with early-stage capitalism. Senators from each state participated in a vote to determine the future course of the nation, ultimately passing the doctrine and signaling a new era of international involvement for United Contana.
NewsProperties.Title: United Contana's Congress Addresses State of the Union and Revolutionary Expansion

NewsProperties.Description: Chairman Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua addressed the world announcing the second successful satellite launch from Rostonur Air Base which has now reached low earth orbit. The chairman praised the scientists and the UCOSM that allowed the country to reach space a second time. The functionality of the satellite was confirmed when radio contact was established after deployment.
NewsProperties.Title: Second Contanan Satellite in Space!

NewsProperties.Description:
HAELM, VALGSLAND - Building upon the foundations of Valgslandian Socialism, inspired by Emmerich Hegel's revolutionary ideas, labor unions are spearheading the next phase of decentralized economic growth and worker empowerment in Valgsland. This unique form of socialism, emphasizing a federal, economic organization of society, continues to reshape the nation's political and economic landscape.

The Valgsland Workers' Cooperative, a successful example of Valgslandian Socialism in practice, has led to a remarkable 17% increase in productivity and an impressive 33% rise in worker satisfaction. Encouraged by these results, calls for the expansion of decentralized structures across various sectors of the economy have gained momentum.

In light of these successes, Valgsland's Minister of Labor, Frida Albrechtsson, recently unveiled a new initiative in Haelm aimed at further expanding infrastructure, promoting scientific and technological advancements. "We believe that the principles of Valgslandian Socialism offer a sustainable and equitable path for our nation's future," Albrechtsson stated during a press conference in Stahlort.

As Valgsland moves forward with Emmerich Hegel's vision of a decentralized, egalitarian society, the nation is solidifying its position as a leader in socialist thought and policy-making, both at home and abroad. With labor unions at the forefront of this movement, the ongoing development of Valgslandian Socialism offers a promising blueprint for other nations seeking to implement similar reforms.
NewsProperties.Title: Valgsland Labor Unions Drive Further Decentralized Economic Growth, Empower Workers

NewsProperties.Description:
This morning, Valgslandian forces has occupied Heljiland with only a small amount of casualties when the forces of Heljiland surrendered after the invasion that was executed yesterday.

After the surrender, Chancellor Hegel had reclaimed Heljiland as part of Valgsland and described the events as the triumph of freedom and reversal of historical injustices.

Agnolian leader Van Hoorten condemned the invasion, and the AN, for leaving Agnolia alone and not interfering. “This was a drastic first step of Valgslandian and Malenyevist invasion in Eastern Merkopa and I’m warning those who allowed them to do this, this is how liberty dies,” he said. Agnolian Navy has also returned back to Staalport after a brief firefight with the Valgslandian forces.
NewsProperties.Title: Valgsland Occupies Heljiland

NewsProperties.Description:
The recent Arcasian elections have come to an end, with incumbent Dwight Walker narrowly winning re-election against Charles Devereaux of the Reformist Union party. Devereaux's campaign was notably sponsored by the prominent private military corporation, Cerberus International. With a margin of just 5 percent, Walker's victory has brought a sense of stability to Ventrie City following a tumultuous campaign season marked by political assassinations and corporate meddling.

Walker's re-election has been attributed to his successful efforts in lifting a significant portion of the population out of poverty during his previous term. However, despite these achievements, Arcasia's economy has recently shown signs of stagnation. Experts argue that the slowdown may be due to the high expenditures associated with the ATO alliance and the ongoing cold war against United Contana.

Adding to the complexity of the political landscape, tensions have risen between Rumburgian migrants and Arcasian citizens. Walker, who has Rumburgian heritage, has faced criticism and suspicion from some segments of the population. Despite these challenges, Walker has emphasized the importance of unity and inclusion in his political agenda.

In his victory speech, President Walker, of the New Democratic Concord, acknowledged the challenges ahead and vowed to work toward a more inclusive and prosperous society, while maintaining Arcasia's core principles.
NewsProperties.Title: Walker Wins Arcasian Election, Stabilizing Ventrie City Amid Economic Stagnation

NewsProperties.Description:
WRACLAWITZ, WEHLEN - Wehzek President Wiktor Smolak on Thursday criticised the Lespian government for bringing Arcasian soldiers ‘close to the borders of Wehlen’.

Last month, Prime Minister Alvarez and President Walker agreed on the construction of several military bases in Lespia that would station ATO soldiers. With the arrival of the first Arcasian soldiers to Lespia this week, Wehlen’s stance has become increasingly hostile.

In his speech on Thursday, Smolak said, ‘President Walker has succeeded in spreading Arcasian imperialism to Eastern Merkopa, which will have consequences for every one of us in the region.’ 

‘ATO is clearly expanding its influence in our region using Lespia. We must be careful,’ said President Smolak, warning the neighbouring nations of Agnolia and Sordland to be prepared for future crises.
NewsProperties.Title: Smolak Condemns Arcasian Soldiers in Lespia

NewsProperties.Description:
WRACLAWITZ, WEHLEN - President Smolak has announced that the city of Vernen has been put under curfew along with seven other towns in the northeast of the country. The Wehzek army has deployed specially trained military forces in the to combat the militant organization known as the Bludish Freedom Front.

Wehlen has increased its efforts in fighting terrorism, with aerial campaigns and ground operations targeting BFF militants and their hidden bases. This operation will surely have consequences for the region, particularly for the neighbouring countries of Lespia, Rumburg and particularly Sordland, which has a large population of Bludish people living inside its borders.
NewsProperties.Title: Wehlen Deploying Special Forces To Vernen

NewsProperties.Description:
A wave of targeted political assassinations struck Ventrie City’s Financial District, claiming the lives of one key campaign staffer and one local district politician preceding Arcasia’s decisive vote. A coordinated drive-by shooting and small explosive detonation aimed at Charles Devereaux’s team heightened fears of election disruption. Palantor Security Solutions aided Arcasian Police at rally sites, while Cerberus International reinforced key transit hubs with rapid-response and surveillance units.

The election comes amid slowing growth, rising military spending, and mounting pressure on working-class communities. President Dwight Walker’s pro-market agenda faces resistance from voters backing Devereaux’s platform for welfare expansion and public oversight. Debates over inequality, migration, and privatized power have polarized the electorate and drawn attention from observers wary of Contana-aligned interference.

In a televised address, Walker condemned the killings, vowed justice, and urged citizens to uphold constitutional values.
NewsProperties.Title: Turmoil Strikes Ventrie City

NewsProperties.Description:
Fort Ales has fallen into Palesian hands, with Rizian defenses overwhelmed following a concentrated attack by Pales’ capable forces. 

Now that the Rizian border city is now lost, internal opposition to the country’s brutal war is reportedly mounting, as many start to question if King Romus’ armies have what it takes to succeed.

In any case, Rizian generals will be under immense pressure to rapidly retake the city, to avoid further backlash.
NewsProperties.Title: Palesian Forces Seize Fort Ales

NewsProperties.Description:
Numbers of displaced civilians fleeing the war zone in Pales are on the rise, with many fleeing either further into Pales or running towards Rizia, hoping that the latter will be welcoming to them. 

Observers worry that as the war continues, more and more people will be forced to leave their homes, potentially resulting in a serious crisis, creating a similar situation to the Wehzek civil war.
NewsProperties.Title: Increasing Number Of Refugees Due Pales-Rizian War

NewsProperties.Description:
The Kingdom of Rizia has once again lost Terador, in what seems like a repeat of the 1926 war, in which the Kingdom eventually had to admit defeat and retreat its forces from Pales. 

With Palesian soldiers once again standing on Rizian ground, many inhabitants question if they will ever leave again.
NewsProperties.Title: Terador Falls Into Palesian Hands

NewsProperties.Description:
Despite international condemnation the first time around, Rizian King Romus has ordered to once again launch a chemical weapon attack on a Palesian city, with Arces being the new target.

Once more, agonizing pictures of the atrocious assault have spread around the world, as casualties are likely to number into the hundreds.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Once Again Deploys Chemical Weapons

NewsProperties.Description:
The world reacts in shock as Rizia has deployed a lethal new weapon, some sort of nerve gas, on the Palesian city of Arces. Hundreds of civilians have been reported dead, as the gas swiftly spread across town, entering every building and supposed ‘safe space’.

The deployment of this new weapon not only shows an intensification of the conflict, in which Rizia’s military shows little respect for Palesian civilian life in its attempts to conquer the Grand Duchy, but also resulted in international condemnation as countries react in horror to the attack.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Unleashes Chemical Weapons On Arces

NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Once Again Deploys Chemical Weapons

NewsProperties.Description:
Our brave soldiers have commenced their assault on the Aledo mountains, a fearsome mountain range that will prove vital in control over the battlefield, as the Palesian soldiers currently occupying it have a wide view of the area thanks to several mountaintop observatories.

Axa Victoria!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Aledo Mountains

NewsProperties.Description:
A brilliant intelligence operation carried out by our finest operatives has brought about an almost slapstick-like sequence of events: Palesian tanks driving in circles, without communications, while several of their key officers defected.

Our troops swiftly acted upon the chaos and swiftly surrounded the remaining division, forcing them to surrender without a bullet fired.

Axa Victoria!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Palesian Armor Lost

NewsProperties.Description:
Our King has only gone and done it! A new, mysterious weapon has been deployed by our troops, swiftly sending the Palesians defending Arces running in terror.

These new wonder weapons will bring us victory!

Axa Victoria!

NewsProperties.Description:
Dear Royal Herald Readers!

My name is Mark Farus, reporter for the Rizian Army’s information department. In this new column I will update you on everything that happens on the frontlines, providing unique insights into the lives of our brave boys and girls fighting for our country!

Axa Victoria!
Glovurius axa Rizia!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Your New Source Of War Time News

NewsProperties.Description:
A devastating and embarrassing blow has been dealt to His Majesty’s war plans, following a string of defeats that culminated in the Palesian seizure of Pales, the most important city on our southern border.

While desperately attempting to hold on to the city, Rizian troops routinely hid near civilian targets, leading to mass civilian casualties as Palesian forces shelled those areas.

With Rizia’s forces clearly routed, we hope the bloodshed can finally come to an end soon.
NewsProperties.Title: Scores Killed As King’s Forces Leave Fort Ales

NewsProperties.Description:
Refugees fleeing their ravaged homes, looking for safer spaces to stay, are reportedly suffering serious abuse at the hands of Rizian soldiers, as the King has ordered his armed thugs to extract information from them about Palesian army positions.

Not even the weak are spared at the hands of our army…
NewsProperties.Title: Refugees Allegedly Beaten For Information

NewsProperties.Description:
Terador has once again changed hands, the last time being during the 1926 war. Once again, the city has witnessed brutal street fighting, with eventually the Rizian garrison being forced to retreat, heads held in shame.

For the citizens of Terador, who were still reeling from the trauma of the last war that left their city in ruins, this must be a terrifying mental blow. We hope they can find peace soon enough.
NewsProperties.Title: Terador’s Inhabitants Once Again Suffer The Horrors Of War

NewsProperties.Description:
The chemical weapons unleashed by our army on innocent Palesian civilians has rightfully shocked the world, as organizations like the internationally respected Watchtower of Human Rights condemn our government for the horrific war crimes committed.  

This raises the question, how was the King able to procure such despicable weaponry? We seriously doubt they are home developed, could perhaps the Queen of Rumburg be behind it?
NewsProperties.Title: Where did Butcher Romus Get His New Toys?

NewsProperties.Description:
The first-annual launch of an event meant to bring together millions of like-minded anti-planet activists fizzled out before leaving the atmosphere. Organized by the group Anti-Planetary Society, against the backdrop of the Alignment of the Six Stars, the march was held outside the Archsanctuary of Plavo as a protest against the commonly held belief in other planets in our universe. However, instead of the expected seven-figure turnout, they managed to gather just seven attendees.

“We had such high expectations,” said Dikki Gubney, president of the fringe organization. “The misguided belief in the theory of planets is one of the greatest tragedies of our times. It’s harming our society and indoctrinating our children's minds with fake science.” 

Given the march’s virtually non-existent attendance, it begs the question… was the dismal turnout, in fact, a sign from the heavens?
NewsProperties.Title: Anti-Planetary Society’s Million Man March Ends in Comic Failure

NewsProperties.Description:
In a rare and symbolic gesture, King Romus rode alongside Prime Minister Daria de Rava to the House of Delegates yesterday to witness the newly displayed national constitution. Their joint arrival was hailed as a powerful sign of unity during this pivotal transition. 

As the nation prepares for its first elections under the reformed bicameral system, the moment underscores a shared commitment to stability and progress. “Their presence together reminds us that tradition and progress need not be at odds,” said Tomaso Elizagarai, senior political analyst at The Royal Harold. Though stepping back from governance, the King remains an emblem of continuity -- an image that may prove defining as Rizia begins this new chapter.
NewsProperties.Title: Tradition Meets Transition

NewsProperties.Description:
Arces, a vital transportation hub straight in the middle of Palesian lands, has fallen to our troops. Not only does this win give our country effective control over the main Palesian railway, but it is also highly symbolic, as it shows the King’s victorious troops have penetrated the Palesian defenses and struck straight at their heartland.

Axa Victoria!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Arces Liberated!

NewsProperties.Description:
An army spokesman has revealed that our brave forces have information about our dear Princess Vina’s location, who is still being held by Palesian forces in god-knows what conditions. The King’s forces are planning a rescue operation as we speak.

We continue to pray together for her safe return!

Axa Victoria!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Army Has Info On Princess Vina’s Whereabouts!

NewsProperties.Description:
Nations across the globe, ranging from CSP to ATO aligned countries, have condemned Rizia for a massacre committed on Palesian land. While the Kingdom blames the Derdian mercenaries it hired as the culprits, many countries have opted to condemn both: Derdia for providing killers for hire, and Rizia for initiating an illegal invasion and employing said killers.

While some nations have described Rizia’s decision to bury the victims as ‘classy’, others have called it an insult and called for a proper punishment of those responsible.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia And Derdia Condemned For Massacre

NewsProperties.Description:
Nations across the globe, ranging from CSP to ATO aligned countries, have condemned Rizia for a massacre committed on Palesian land. While the Kingdom blames the Derdian mercenaries it hired as the culprits, many countries have opted to condemn both: Derdia for providing killers for hire, and Rizia for initiating an illegal invasion and employing said killers.

Rizia responded by punishing the Derdian mercenaries, putting some in front of a military tribunal and dismissing the group all together.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia And Derdia Condemned For Massacre

NewsProperties.Description:
The Kingdom of Rizia is continuing its controversial usage of chemical weapons, despite international condemnation, against Palesian cities. 

This time, the Palesian capital was the target, as Rizian forces continue to lay siege upon the city. Once again, scores of civilian casualties have been reported, in what appears to be yet another war crime.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Uses Nerve Gas Against Pales

NewsProperties.Description:
The Kingdom of Rizia is continuing its controversial usage of chemical weapons, despite international condemnation, against Palesian cities. 

This time, the Palesian city of Remaz was the target, as Rizian forces continue to lay siege upon the city. Once again, scores of civilian casualties have been reported, in what appears to be yet another war crime.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Uses Nerve Gas Against Pales

NewsProperties.Description:
The Kingdom of Rizia is continuing its controversial usage of chemical weapons, despite international condemnation, against Palesian cities. 

This time, the Palesian city of Solles was the target, as Rizian forces continue to lay siege upon the city. Once again, scores of civilian casualties have been reported, in what appears to be yet another war crime.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Uses Nerve Gas Against Pales

NewsProperties.Description:
Pales, the capital of the Grand Duchy, has fallen into Rizian hands.

Despite strong Palesian resistance, with fierce urban warfare claiming thousands of Rizian casualties, the Kingdom’s troops eventually managed to gain control over the city.

Currently, Grand Duke Axel Reinhart’s whereabouts remain unknown, but most international observers expect the Palesian government to surrender any day now, as their resistance to Rizia’s invasion appears fully broken.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Victorious As Pales’ Capital Falls

NewsProperties.Description:
Remaz, a city with a pre-war population of nearly one million, has fallen into Rizian hands. Much of the city's population already fled as Rizian troops approached, to avoid the expected siege.

With the fall of Remaz, Palesian forces have essentially been forced to retreat to Pales proper, as the war has decisively turned into Rizia’s favor.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizian Troops Seize Second Largest Palesian City

NewsProperties.Description:
While the majority of Palesians support their liberation by King Romus’ forces, gladly accepting their return to our Golden Kingdom, a small minority has launched an uprising in the cities of Ziqes and Arces.

Luckily, our brave troops were prepared for such an eventuality and are moving in swiftly to crush them. Let this be a warning to all traitors!

Axa Victoria!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Ungrateful Palesians Rebel

NewsProperties.Description:
Some of our most elite troops have successfully rescued an important intelligence asset from the clutches of his Palesian captors. During the daring rescue, which is the stuff war movies will be made off long after our victory, the asset’s captors were swiftly dealt with.

Unfortunately, our asset was severely bruised, a clear sign of maltreatment at the hands of Palesian brutes. I wish him a speedy recovery!

Axa Victoria!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Our Forces Stage Daring Rescue

NewsProperties.Description:
Our brave troops have seized a vital Palesian naval command base. While our enemy clearly assumed the base to be hidden, His Majesty’s forces located and successfully took over the base without much difficulty.

Since the base served as the main command center for the Palesian navy, their communications have now been severed, drastically reducing the effectiveness of their navy to coordinate meaningful resistance against us!

Axa Victoria!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Enemy Naval Capabilities Crushed!

NewsProperties.Description:
Our beloved Princess Vina is coming home.

Thanks to the diligent efforts of our brave soldiers, who executed a daring rescue raid, Princess Vina is now on her safe return home.

While we anxiously await a reaction by Vina, as we are dying to hear how she’s been treated in captivity, we respect the Princess’ choice to remain silent for now and focus on her recovery.

Axa Victoria!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Princess Vina Rescued!

NewsProperties.Description:
As the sounds of gunfire finally died down and Rizia’s flag was raised on top of the Pales Citadel, I witnessed something incredible: a rainbow emerged clearing up the dense cloud coverage, a sure sign that the heavens are smiling upon our victorious troops.

The troops who, under the guiding hand of King Romus The Conqueror, seized the Palesian capital and returned it to Rizia for the first time in centuries. 

It’s expected that the last vestiges of Palesian resistance will soon fade, as the country will inevitably surrender. Duke Reinhart’s whereabouts are currently unknown, but our army is dutifully searching for him across his former capital.

Axa Victoria!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Pales Is Ours

NewsProperties.Description:
The second largest Palesian city, Remaz, has been liberated by our glorious King’s army! True bravery was displayed by many individual soldiers and commanders, with medals awarded to those that went above and beyond for their fatherland.

Axa Victoria!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Remaz Is Ours!

NewsProperties.Description:
Despite a valiant effort of our enemy’s soldiers to defend Solles, the city has fallen into the hands of our clearly superior army. 

The city, located at a strategic chokepoint on the edge of the Pales peninsula, is a vital piece of our final victory. Pales will soon be Rizian again!

Axa Victoria!
NewsProperties.Title: Mark Farus’ From The Frontlines: Gateway To Pales Falls

NewsProperties.Description:
Numerous Palesian civilians and resistance fighters have launched an uprising against Rizian military occupation in the cities of Ziqes and Arces, aiming to liberate their homes from the near genocidal rule of King Romus.

We salute these heroes and wish them courage!
NewsProperties.Title: Brave Palesians Resist

NewsProperties.Description:
Reportedly, the King’s forces have severely abused and beaten several surrendering Palesian soldiers, in a desperate attempt to extract information to them. This is yet another clear violation of international law, which says prisoners of war have to be treated with dignity.

It’s becoming increasingly clear that the King’s troops have no dignity left in them, and that the Wruhecist values of ‘compassion’ and ‘charity’ they once championed hold no real value to them.
NewsProperties.Title: Rumors Of Beatings Surface As King’s Forces Seize Solles

NewsProperties.Description:
A gruesome mass grave, filled with not only soldiers but also civilians, was uncovered in Pales. An ‘investigation’ conducted by our army points to the Derdian mercenaries, hired by King Romus, as the perpetrators of the massacre.

We regard the evidence put forward by the Crown as insufficient. Even if the Derdians did it, the orders still came from above, from our very own Rizian commanders. It’s easy to blame a foreign entity for your own crimes!
NewsProperties.Title: Romus Blames Derdians For His Own Orders

NewsProperties.Description:
Romus the Slaughterer has authorized the usage of chemical weapons on the Palesian capital of Pales, once again resulting in hundreds of innocent dead civilians.

We reiterate: the nerve gas used by the Rizian army is a gruesome way to go, as victims feel they are being burned from the inside out. No one deserves this, especially not civilians. It is a clear war crime!

We truly hope that the perpetrators can be judged in a court one day.
NewsProperties.Title: Pales Gassed – Another Day, Another Massacre

NewsProperties.Description:
The international community is condemning Rizia’s use of chemical agents in Pales, with reports indicating severe health crises among civilians. The deployment, allegedly supported by Rumburg, has resulted in widespread respiratory and neurological damage, overwhelming local medical facilities. "At the hospital, even the rescue team was struggling to breathe and some first responders started convulsing and collapsing," recounted one survivor.

Global leaders and human rights organizations are calling for an immediate investigation and cessation of hostilities. The crisis underscores the urgent need for diplomatic negotiations to prevent further loss of life and to uphold international humanitarian standards. "People are suffocating, frothing at the mouth, screaming in the streets," the survivor's testimony highlights. The situation in Pales demands a swift and coordinated global response.
NewsProperties.Title: Chemical Attack in Pales Draws Global Condemnation

NewsProperties.Description:
The Kingdom of Rizia’s decree banning all non-Nurity faiths has drawn sharp condemnation from the Republic of Qinal, where Zaranism is the dominant religion. Prime Minister Reza Ngoda denounced the decision as an unprecedented violation of religious freedom, warning that such policies could destabilize the region.

In Qinal's major cities, religious leaders and human rights advocates have begun calling on the international community to take a stand. Diplomatic tensions are rising as other nations weigh their response to Rizia's crackdown on religious minorities.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia’s Religious Ban Sparks Outrage

NewsProperties.Description: News about Rizia’s expanding intelligence program has worried Wehlen officials, especially within its Zille administration. While Wehlen and Rizia both remain formally committed to a peaceful reunification of Zille with Rizia, the former has warned Rizia to refrain from covert operations on its territory, saying it could endanger relations between the two countries.
NewsProperties.Title: Expansion of Rizian Intelligence Operations Puts Wehlen On Edge

NewsProperties.Description:
The Kingdom of Rizia has acquired a fleet of state-of-the-art bomber aircraft in a move that highlights both its economic might and shifting priorities toward military expansion. While officials herald the purchase as crucial for national defense, regional analysts caution that the bomber deal may escalate tensions by projecting force to neighboring countries, threatening the delicate geopolitical balance in South Merkopa. 

As King Romus cultivates global trade relationships and domestic prosperity grows, this focus on strengthening offensive capabilities marks a strategic change that could strain diplomatic ties.
NewsProperties.Title: Bomber Acquisition Raises Concerns

NewsProperties.Description:
The Kingdom of Rizia's acquisition of cutting-edge fighter jets, portrayed as essential for strengthening air defenses in an increasingly volatile region, has sparked a mix of support and criticism domestically and internationally. 

While officials emphasize the need for robust military deterrence, skeptics argue that the substantial investment may undermine economic priorities and be seen as provocative by neighboring countries, potentially shifting the regional balance of power and diverting resources from crucial domestic reforms.
NewsProperties.Title: Kingdom's Fighter Jet Purchase Sparks Debate

NewsProperties.Description:
The Kingdom's Royal Defense Department has announced the procurement of a fleet of new military support vehicles from international manufacturers, a strategic move to enhance the nation's logistics and supply chain capabilities as regional tensions simmer. 

The acquisition, part of an ongoing modernization program, highlights growing concerns over territorial disputes with neighboring countries, signaling the kingdom's readiness to address potential conflicts in the South Merkopan region.
NewsProperties.Title: Military Vehicles Acquired By Rizian Monarch

NewsProperties.Description:
Rizia has confirmed the acquisition of a new fleet of battle tanks. The purchase, which government officials have described as a step towards strengthening national defense, occurs against the backdrop of heightened tensions with the monarchy's neighbors.

International analysts have cautioned that the agreement could prove detrimental to Rizia's standing with the AN, who has previously advocated for de-escalation in the region. In light of the kingdom's assertive defense strategy, experts anticipate a shift in geopolitical dynamics, potentially disrupting the precarious equilibrium of power in Southern Merkopa.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Expands Military Arsenal

NewsProperties.Description:
Observers across the Merkopa are watching Rizia’s new Crown Supreme Campaign with interest, noting its clear intent to centralize symbolic power around the Toras dynasty and His Majesty Romus. The campaign, which spans media, education, and public exhibitions, is seen as a calculated effort to reinforce the monarchy’s role in shaping civic identity amid shifting domestic currents.

While the initiative has reportedly bolstered national morale and improved the Kingdom’s image abroad, some analysts interpret it as a preemptive response to elite fragmentation and rising popular demands. As republican and socialist ideas continue to gain ground across the region, the Crown's strategy stands out for placing royal continuity, not radical reform, at the center of its national vision.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia’s Monarchy Reasserts Itself With Cultural Push

NewsProperties.Description:
As part of rising anti-immigrant sentiment within the country, Rizia’s government announced that it’s stepping up border policing operations, citing the need to step up the fight against illegal immigration and increasing drug trade.

Human rights groups have expressed worries about the murkiness surrounding operations of the border guards, claiming that no legal mechanisms exist to hold them to account.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Tightens Border Security

NewsProperties.Description:
After Rizia’s drastic move to legalize an expansive list of illegal substances, including infamous drugs like yishyash and ratspice, some countries in the region have expressed their dissatisfaction with the kingdom. Fear exists that Rizia will become a safe haven for smugglers and turn into a distribution system for the entire region. 

Derdia, which in recent years has struggled with drug influx from Agard, warned that it’s considering putting travel restrictions to Rizia in place.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia’s Neighbors Worried About Drug Legalization

NewsProperties.Description:
